reuse.why: Extends the single existing isWeekendOrHoliday check that every holiday consumer already calls, reusing monthUtils.dayFromDate for the date key.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is derived from the same day string in one small function.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend/holiday logic it extends.

scope.why: One helper, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Holiday matching is now in one documented private helper behind the existing public function; trivial to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks (shared/schedules.ts, server/schedules/app.ts, schedule-template via getDateWithSkippedWeekend) go through isWeekendOrHoliday.
